title: IPsec Site-to-Site VPN Wizard (v1)
acceptance_criteria: Wizard can create one site-to-site IPsec tunnel (Phase 1 + Phase 2) from UI with minimal inputs.
Wizard configures required firewall/NAT so traffic flows (IKE/ESP/NAT-T as applicable).
Wizard is idempotent or clearly warns before overwriting config it created.
Wizard failures surface actionable errors and avoid silently leaving partial config.
Automated tests exist for backend parsing/build/apply logic.
assumptions: v1 targets IPv4, IKEv2, PSK auth, single tunnel.
Default mode (policy-based vs VTI) is TBD; must be confirmed by Mark.
Wizard-created config will be tagged with a stable description/prefix for detection and cleanup.

tasks.notes: Produce Feature Spec Packet (wizard steps, validations, VyOS semantics, firewall/NAT behavior).
Convert spec into implementation plan, milestones, rollback, and test strategy.
Add wizard apply endpoint(s) and any helper services/builders; ensure RBAC gates.
Add wizard UI flow (similar to existing setup wizards) with validation and review/apply step.
Add/extend automated tests; run locally and document commands + results.
Review for security (RBAC), correctness, idempotency, and edge cases.
Update docs and verification steps; prep PR summary.
